steps.name: android-host-graphics
steps.subject: Nested Wayland backend on the Android host: KGSL render device, Android buffer allocator, flat output
steps.description:
KWin runs nested in the APK compositor. MOTO_KWIN_RENDER_DEVICE selects /dev/kgsl-3d0 for EGL and
limits linux-dmabuf to v3; MOTO_GPU_ALLOCATOR allocates output buffers from the host (AHardwareBuffer)
instead of GBM; MOTO_KWIN_FLAT_OUTPUT maps a scaled output 1:1 onto the host surface (pointer and
touch positions divided by the scale); MOTO_KWIN_ANDROID_SHM places SHM buffers in /dev/shm.

steps.name: screencast-mobile-shell
steps.subject: Screencast: do not exclude the Plasma Mobile shell when it is the recorder
steps.description:
Plasma Mobile records from its own shell process; excluding the recorder's PID also removed the
wallpaper, launcher and panels (a black home screen). Per-window excludeFromCapture still applies.
Currently gated on MOTO_KWIN_FLAT_OUTPUT; an upstream version would key on the shell, not the host.

steps.name: screencast-gles-readback
steps.subject: Screencast: no GLES readback flip on the flat Android output
steps.description:
The nested GLES framebuffer on the Android host already follows the bottom-left readback
convention; flipping it again made SHM screencasts upside down.

steps.subject: KWin: timestamped FTrace markers around the Android output handoff
steps.description:
Write trace_marker through a plain fd with one write() per marker. The
QFile-based logger batched markers (invalid kernel timestamps) and, once
re-enabled over D-Bus, failed every write with "QFile::at: Cannot set
file position 0". Add GpuWait (glFinish) and Import durations to the
Wayland EGL layer so a trace shows Paint -> GPU wait -> buffer handoff.
Packaged as 6.6.6-0ubuntu0.1+moto7.
steps.name: ftrace-fd-markers

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Pending [the QFile batching bug is upstream; the GpuWait/Import markers are host specific]

steps.subject: KWin: send the output's GPU completion fence instead of glFinish
steps.description:
When the Android host offers zwp_linux_explicit_synchronization_v1 (KGSL has
no DRM syncobj), export an EGL native fence for each output frame and attach
it with set_acquire_fence in the same commit; the render thread no longer
blocks in glFinish. MOTO_KWIN_EXPLICIT_SYNC=-1 restores the old path.
Packaged as 6.6.6-0ubuntu0.1+moto8. Measured: Paint p50 6.7 -> 2.0 ms.
steps.name: explicit-sync-acquire-fence

steps.subject: KWin: UBWC output buffers and host-restart recovery (moto9, moto10)
steps.description:
moto9: with MOTO_KWIN_UBWC=1 the Android allocator asks the host for
QCOM_COMPRESSED buffers (lease protocol v2 carries the wanted and the
allocated modifier).
moto10: on the Android host, wait for the host socket at startup, and when
the host connection breaks wait for it to return and exit with 133, so
kwin_wayland_wrapper restarts KWin without counting a crash and without a
core dump; clients no longer reconnect into a window with no KWin.
steps.name: ubwc-host-restart

steps.subject: KWin moto12: cast cursor, host text input, raw host outputs
steps.description:
- Cast outputs get no cursor layer; KWin renders the cursor into the TV frame.
- Host wl_outputs are read from the raw protocol (HostOutput). KWayland's
  Output::addMode() erases from a QList while holding an iterator and crashed
  KWin whenever the host re-announced a mode (phone refresh changes). Host
  outputs are released before the connection closes.
- Text the host commits over text-input-v3 (Android keyboard: Chinese, emoji)
  goes to InputMethod::commitHostText and the focused client.
- KWIN_IM_SHOW_ALWAYS applies to text fields on internal outputs only; automatic
  panel requests for a field on the TV do not show the on-screen keyboard.
- A cast output takes the lowest free CAST-n name so a reconnected TV keeps
  its scale.
steps.name: cast-cursor-host-text-raw-outputs

steps.subject: Cast: keep the TV running with the app in the background or the screen off
steps.description:
With the phone surface suspended, render_all now serves only the cast
window: its new buffers go to the TV presenter and only it gets frame
callbacks. The compositor loop waits on the Wayland fds instead of the
phone's Choreographer, so the TV keeps KWin's own 60 Hz pace even with
the phone screen off.

Cast presentation feedback is reported on the cast output at its own
refresh rate (the phone's rate kept switching CAST-1 between 120 and
30 Hz) and for every cast commit. An unchanged TV buffer is no longer
presented again on every phone frame. update_output_mode skips windows
when nothing changed, and native-stats gains cast counters.

KWin moto14: a host configure without a size change no longer
re-queries the outputs. Returning to the foreground rebuilt every
output's scene view and could leave the cast output frozen for good.
APK 1.33.
steps.name: cast-background

steps.subject: Desktop automation types through KWin, not the Android host
steps.description:
KWin moto15 adds VirtualKeyboard.commitText(): the text goes to the
focused field the way an input method commits it (text-input v1/v2/v3,
else key events), so any language works without the on-screen keyboard.
moto-cua uses it instead of the Android host's text-commit path, which
went through the APK and back and failed with Plasma in the background.

desktop_launch matches app names in every language of the .desktop file:
the session runs in en_US while requests come in Chinese.
steps.name: virtualkeyboard-commit-text

steps.subject: KWin moto16: a minimum size above the maximum no longer disconnects the client
steps.description:
WeChat 4.1 (static Qt 6) sizes its main window's maximum from Qt's primary
screen, the first wl_output KWin announces (the 360 px wide phone), while
its minimum width is larger; the invalid_size protocol error killed it right
after logging in, also when the window was on the TV. KWin now logs the
conflict and drops the conflicting maximum instead. Verified with a
wayland-client probe committing min 700x400 / max 360x800.
steps.name: xdg-min-above-max

steps.subject: KWin moto17: host scrolling keeps its source, its stop and the output scale
steps.description:
The nested Wayland backend forwarded host axis events as a wheel of unknown
source without axis_stop, and in host pixels while positions are divided by a
flat output's scale: two-finger scrolling on the TV (CAST-1 at 1.75) went 1.75
times too far and clients scrolled it as a wheel. Now axis_source is kept, a
stop goes on as a zero delta (as libinput reports finger scrolling), the delta
is divided by the scale, and host finger scrolling is marked natural.
steps.name: host-scroll-source-stop-scale
